facts.fact: 不锈钢滚珠以每秒逾 25,000 英尺的速度向外爆射；约旦三重间谍（同时是医生）最先死亡，死时面带微笑、低声用阿拉伯语说出 “There is no god but God”。
facts.anchor: The stainless-steel ball bearings blasted outward at more than 25,000 feet per second. The Jordanian triple agent, a medical doctor, died first, smiling and quietly uttering to himself the words “There is no god but God” in Arabic.

facts.fact: 两名军官（一名前 Special Forces 士兵、一名前 Navy SEAL）站得离他最近，并正快速走向这名约旦医生；他们因注意到他始终不把左手从 vest 口袋拿出，而他随即在 gym building 旁引爆了随身隐藏的炸弹；两人最后听到的是他向上帝的祈祷。
facts.anchor: Two officers, one a former Special Forces soldier and the other a former Navy SEAL, were standing closest to him. They were, in fact, both moving rapidly toward the Jordanian doctor when he set off his hidden bomb next to the gym building at Forward Operating Base █████ , having noticed how he wouldn’t take his left hand out of his vest pocket. The last thing each of them heard was his prayer to Allah.

facts.fact: 基地站长（Chief of Base，女性）也死亡，她随身带着的柠檬海绵生日蛋糕被气化。
facts.anchor: The Chief of Base died too. The lemon sponge birthday cake she was carrying was vaporized.

facts.fact: 另有四名 CIA 官员当场死亡，其中一人站在五十英尺外；另有六人受伤；许多人聚集是为这名约旦人的到来举行庆祝，大家正准备唱 “Happy Birthday” 却没来得及。
facts.anchor: Four other CIA officers died on the spot, including one standing fifty feet away. Six more were wounded. It seems a lot of people had gathered for the Jordanian’s arrival, since it was to be a celebration. Everyone was getting ready to sing “Happy Birthday,” but they never had the time.

facts.fact: 飞散的金属直接切穿这名特工抵达时所乘的红色 Subaru 旅行车，杀死站在车另一侧的三个人；死者中包括约旦情报机构的一名代表以及这辆 Subaru 的阿富汗司机。
facts.anchor: The flying metal cut right through the red Subaru station wagon in which the agent had arrived, killing three people standing on the other side. Among the dead was a representative of the Jordanian intelligence service, as well as the Afghan driver of the Subaru.

facts.fact: 匿名机构官员在 off-the-record 评论中把反情报疏漏的责任归给基地站长，并透露她无视了 CIA 总部最后一刻打来的直接命令——该命令要求她在把该特工带入基地前对他彻底搜身。
facts.anchor: When unnamed Agency officials provided off-the-record comments, blame for the counterintelligence lapse was assigned to the Chief of Base. Those unnamed officials revealed that she had disregarded a direct order called in at the last minute from CIA Headquarters instructing her to search the agent thoroughly before bringing him onto the compound.

facts.fact: CIA 发言人发表官方声明，声明称：“While the Agency mourns the deaths of these brave officers as a result of errors made by a few low-level employees, it is important to keep in mind CIA’s many, many successes in her efforts to protect America.”
facts.anchor: CIA’s spokesman issued an official statement. It read: “While the Agency mourns the deaths of these brave officers as a result of errors made by a few low-level employees, it is important to keep in mind CIA’s many, many successes in her efforts to protect America.”
